title: 弗吉尼亚大提琴手走红
desc: 弗吉尼亚大提琴手走红

paragraphs.en: Meet Andrew Savoia, a 24-year-old Northern Virginia cello player who is a social media sensation.
paragraphs.zh: 认识一下安德鲁·沙瓦亚，一位24岁的北弗吉尼亚大提琴手，他在社交媒体上很有名。

paragraphs.en: He created his TikTok account savoiboi in July and in just a few months he already had millions of likes or views.
paragraphs.zh: 他在7月创建了自己的TikTok账号savoiboi，短短几个月内就已经获得了数百万的点赞或浏览量。

paragraphs.en: There were some very catchy songs on the app and songs that you're just watching a video and it makes you want to get up and dance.
paragraphs.zh: 这个应用程序上有一些非常动听的歌曲，而且当你观看视频时 ，里面的歌曲会让你忍不住起身跳舞。

paragraphs.en: And there was only like a quick little segment of that I would see and I was like, okay, I could try to recreate this on the cello, so I did that.
paragraphs.zh: 我当时只能看到一小段快速闪过的内容，我就想，好吧，我可以试着用大提琴把这个重新演绎出来，于是我就这么做了。

paragraphs.en: I had one of my buddies record it and it was so fascinating because of the positive reaction that it received. I did not think that it would be received as well as it did.
paragraphs.zh: 我有一个朋友帮我录了下来，结果反响非常热烈，这让我觉得特别有意思。我没想到它会受到这么好的评价。

paragraphs.en: It was a stream of unhappy events that led Savoia to his social media success: a painful breakup, failing to get into medical school, depression.
paragraphs.zh: 一连串不幸的事件促使沙瓦亚在社交媒体上获得了成功：痛苦的分手、医学院入学考试失利以及抑郁情绪。

paragraphs.en: In a strange way all this contributed to his achievements.
paragraphs.zh: 奇怪的是，这一切都促成了他的成就。

paragraphs.en: Music for me has been a way for me to like, I said, process emotion, experiences, memories that I've had.
paragraphs.zh: 对我来说，音乐是一种处理我所经历的情感、体验和记忆的方式。

paragraphs.en: But it has an ability to heal because it can do the same thing for other people and it's very unifying.
paragraphs.zh: 但它具有治愈的能力，因为它也能为他人带来同样的作用，而且非常具有凝聚力。

paragraphs.en: His process is simple: Find the song he likes and play it on the cello.
paragraphs.zh: 他的做法很简单：找到他喜欢的歌曲，然后用大提琴演奏。

paragraphs.en: I listen to lots of different kinds of music. I listen to hip hop. I listen to rock music, country music, sometimes lots of classical music and countless other genres.
paragraphs.zh: 我听很多不同类型的音乐。我听嘻哈音乐。我听摇滚音乐、乡村音乐，有时也听很多古典音乐，还有数不清的其他音乐类型。

paragraphs.en: And I just try to do songs that have a melody line that would work well on this instrument. This instrument has such a diversity in its sound.
paragraphs.zh: 我只是尽力创作那些旋律线在这件乐器上能演奏出很好效果的歌曲。这件乐器的音色非常多样。

paragraphs.en: But music will not be Savoia's career. He graduated from Virginia Tech with a degree in neurobiology and plans to become a neurologist in the future.
paragraphs.zh: 但音乐不会成为沙瓦亚的职业。他毕业于弗吉尼亚理工大学，获得了神经生物学学位，并且计划未来成为一名神经科医生。

paragraphs.en: But his two passions, music and medicine, are inseparable, something one of his former teachers sees as well.
paragraphs.zh: 但他对音乐和医学的两大热忱密不可分。他以前的老师也看到了这一点。

paragraphs.en: I could definitely see a specific you know sector of the population who has a specific ear or depending on the type of illness that you have that you can actually be soothed by music.
paragraphs.zh: 我绝对能想象到有这样一部分特定的人群，他们对音乐有独特的感知，或者根据你所患疾病的类型，实际上你是可以从音乐中获得慰藉的。

paragraphs.en: And if you watch him when he plays, and of course I only started watching him recently, he's very very passionate how he actually started playing the cello. I think that process sort of healed him.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你看他演奏时，当然我也是最近才开始关注他的，他对自己当初是如何开始拉大提琴这件事充满了激情。我觉得这个过程在某种程度上治愈了他。

paragraphs.en: Savoia's cover version of the song Come Get Her by a hip-hop duo Rae Sremmurd got over 3 million views.
paragraphs.zh: 沙瓦亚翻唱了嘻哈二人组雷·什里默德的歌曲Come Get Her，视频浏览量超过了300万。

paragraphs.en: He hopes people who like his stuff will pick up an instrument themselves.
paragraphs.zh: 他希望喜欢他作品的人，能自己拿起一件乐器来演奏。
